structured.feedback: The description is about 230 words in Markdown, under the 300 limit, with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the weak-flosser complaint, the missing-stand complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, "firmer" gums (not in the listing), and "both devices" having non-slip grips (the listing says this only for the flosser).
